address: 428/1 Namueang Road, Talat, Mueang Surat Thani, Surat Thani, 84000, Thailand
bio: This simple eatery is always bustling at lunchtime with queues for both dine-in and takeout. The owner's inviting and chatty demeanour sets the scene. His signature barbeque pork comes with crispy pork and sweet sausage inside and a large portion only costs 40 baht....
